maya_s: Heads-up — enterprise customer (private deployment) can't import our Python SDK in their Docker image after switching to Poetry v1.5. Error: ImportError: cannot import name 'AsyncClient' from 'redwood_sdk.http'

maya_s: Repro steps they sent:
```
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock ./
RUN pip install poetry && poetry install --no-dev
python -c "import redwood_sdk; from redwood_sdk import AsyncClient"
```

alex_c: Hmm, do they use extras? we moved httpx out to extras in 2.x

maya_s: They said they used `poetry add redwood-sdk` (default, no extras)

raj_p: That explains ImportError. Without [http] extras, AsyncClient (httpx wrapper) missing. But why didn't poetry resolve a subdependency? Usually httpx is optional.

maya_s: They tried `pip install .` in local dev, same issue. Also they hit SSL handshake errors in prod (requests.exceptions.SSLError) after switching to 3.11 image

support-bot: Automated note: package metadata shows optional-deps: httpx,crypto

alex_c: SSL errors could be caused by missing certifi or cryptography if extras not installed. Check pip list

maya_s: Got pip list:
```
redwood-sdk 2.3.0
httpcore 0.17.0
# no certifi or cryptography
```

raj_p: So poetry installed minimal runtime. Workaround: `poetry add "redwood-sdk[http,crypto]"` or `pip install "redwood-sdk[full]"`

maya_s: Customer tried `poetry add redwood-sdk[http,crypto]` -> import works locally but in their Docker CI image still fails with AttributeError: module 'httpx' has no attribute 'AsyncClient'

alex_c: That suggests httpx version mismatch. Which httpx installed? 

maya_s: httpx 0.24.0

raj_p: AsyncClient is present in httpx for many versions; attribute error likely from a package shadowing 'httpx' in sys.path. Ask for `python -c "import httpx; print(httpx.__file__, httpx.__version__)"`

maya_s: Customer ran that -> `/app/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/httpx/__init__.pyc 0.24.0`

alex_c: ok not shadowed. Could be they have a pinned httpcore that is incompatible. Try upgrading httpcore and httpx to latest compatible set: `pip install --upgrade httpx httpcore` or `poetry add -D "httpx>=0.24.1"`

raj_p: Also confirm they don't have a top-level module named httpx.py in their project.

maya_s: After upgrading httpx+httpcore and installing extras, they still saw intermittent 401s against our hosted API -> token in headers was missing in their runtime because of env var not passed into Docker run in CI.

alex_c: So multiple issues: extras -> missing certs -> SSL; httpx versions/shadowing -> AsyncClient import; env propagation -> auth 401. 

maya_s: I'll send them a checklist and a minimal reproducible Dockerfile + exact install pins. Drafting now :writing_hand:

raj_p: Great. Add note about ephemeral caches — our SDK will fallback to unauthenticated mode if REDWOOD_API_KEY unset (we should log better) :eyes:

support-bot: Incident flag cleared

maya_s: Customer confirmed all fixed after pins and ensuring REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI. Closing. :white_check_mark:
